vc_checking.summary: All three current manual witnesses are semantically proofable from the generated preconditions and the annotation-approved DLL/sequence specifications. The entail witness splits the owned DLL segment at the first occurrence of the queried node. The two return witnesses use the same decomposition and then rejoin the prefix, queried-node links, and suffix; the tail branch obtains 0 from an empty suffix, while the non-tail branch obtains node_next from the nonempty suffix head. No annotation/spec repair or group-local case_lib helper declaration is required.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Choose nodes_before/nodes_after at the first occurrence of linklist_node_pre in nodes. Inductively unfold xizi_dllseg through nodes_before; at the selected node expose its existential next pointer as node_next and use the incoming predecessor as node_prev.
witnesses.space_plan: Prove a local segment-splitting fact by induction on nodes_before. Each unfold preserves the prefix link cell and eventually exposes xizi_dll_links linklist_node_pre node_next node_prev and the suffix segment. When refolding a nonempty prefix, discharge node inequality from disjoint ownership of link fields (duplicate stores would contradict separation).

Recursing xizi_double_link_next_value over that prefix always takes the unequal branch and takes the equal branch at linklist_node_pre, yielding xizi_double_link_first_value nodes_after. Non-nullness of the queried node is a conjunct of the nonempty dllseg branch; sentinel non-nullness is already PreH1.

analysis_groups.shared_proof_pattern: Expose or consume the queried-node cut in xizi_dllseg, use disjoint link ownership for address inequalities, establish the suffix-head value, and preserve/reclose the original DLL ownership.
analysis_groups.shared_space_plan: Segment split for the entail VC; inverse segment join plus xizi_dll_close for both return VCs.
analysis_groups.shared_pure_plan: First-occurrence recursion establishes the sequence successor; empty versus nonempty suffix distinguishes the 0 and node_next returns.
analysis_groups.grouping_reason: All witnesses are from one straight-line function, use the same xizi_dllseg/xizi_dll ownership decomposition and link-distinctness family, and can be handled sequentially by one worker. The group contains 3 witnesses, below the controller limit of 12.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: For entail_wit_1, select the segment-form generated disjunct, choose the first list occurrence, and inductively split xizi_dllseg around the queried node. For return_wit_1, prove the suffix empty from node_next = sentinel, derive return 0, join the fields/segments, and close xizi_dll. For return_wit_2, prove the suffix head equals node_next from node_next <> sentinel, derive the returned successor, then use the same join/close route. Keep any Hlinks_neq/Hsplit/Hstop_nil/Hvalue/Hjoin facts local to proof bodies; no case_lib helper is needed.
proof_groups.natural_language_proof_strategy: Use the annotation's first-occurrence decomposition as the bridge between full-sequence next-value semantics and the circular DLL ownership. The entail proof exposes that cut; both return proofs consume it and restore the original DLL. Tail/non-tail is decided solely by whether the exposed node_next is the sentinel.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: Same function, same DLL segment decomposition/reassembly family, same address-distinctness argument, and only three witnesses (within max_witnesses_per_group = 12). Splitting would duplicate proof context and provide no dependency or strategy benefit.
